Dear Customer,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. We acknowledge the receipt of your inquiry regarding [Charger offline and to change the main screen logo and to add the screensaver]. Rest assured that a regional representative will promptly contact you to provide further information.
Below, you will find the relevant asset details:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N9 160381801
Charger ID/Serial No.:
7JsGX4
Problem Description:
[Charger offline and to change the main screen logo and to add the screensaver].
As we're seeing that the charger is currently offline, the following requests cannot be changed until the charger comes back online. We need to plan for a site intervention to first bring the charger back online.
Also, regarding the logo that needs to be added and the screensaver images that need to be uploaded, please share both images. If the screensaver has more than one picture, kindly let us know the sequence in which the images should be displayed on the HMI.
For future reference, your case number is
0409274
. Please refer to this number in all further communication related to this issue.
We appreciate your time and patience.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma

additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Stromnetz Hamburg GmbH
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N9 160381801
Charger ID/Serial No.:
7JsGX4
Problem Description:
Charger offline & change Logo and screensaver
We need to change the charger configuration to add the logo to the main screen of the HMI and update the screensaver configuration. However, the charger is currently offline. We need to plan a site intervention to bring the charger back online. Please carry a spare router, an extra SIM card, and a couple of Ethernet cables. Check the configuration by directly connecting the Ethernet cable to the router's web UI. Below is the router MLFB for your reference.
MLFB : 8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8(XF3/XF4)
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [09/01/2024], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
